tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create TWO tall full-body poses side by side in a clean1-row2-column layout, each exactly half the canvas width. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted African Wild Dog shown in image1; identity features: 大きい丸耳・褐色黒色の大斑・白い尾先. Preserve the reference’s large head, exact torso LENGTH and WIDTH, short upright two-legged body and two arm-like forepaws. Never shorten/slim the torso or enlarge the head relative to it. Keep exactly the existing2 arms,2 legs and existing tail/horns/ears; do not create a tail on a tailless reference. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 THINK: One existing forepaw gently touches chin, curious head tilt, torso stable. 2 AHA: Small pleased discovery reaction: head perks and one forepaw slightly lifts, friendly eyes; no lightbulb/effect. Species constraint: 尾の根元は胴へ一か所だけ接続。尾長・太さ・先端色を変えず、胴を横へ移したり尾を二重に描いたりしない。 Clean bounded color areas and connected silhouettes; no pigment spills, background haze or extra marks. Do not insert an additional neutral; it is reused from image1.
